releaseNotes:
Notes v1.8.181 (Build 353):
• Jumping to an older date in chat now opens directly without loading everything in between
• Reduced chat archive storage size by compacting saved message defaults
• WhatsApp and Telegram icons now keep their original colours across chat and shared links
• Imported WhatsApp and Telegram links count as opened by default
• Simplified Today only privacy options and fixed fullscreen YouTube Shorts header spacing
